summary.headline: Week 1 post-redesign read: position recovering. GSC weighted position improved from 20.36 last week to 17.81 this week — closing the gap to the 17.21 baseline (now within 0.60 positions). June 3 hit position 12.25 — best single day in the post-launch window. GA4 sessions +3.6% WoW (465 vs 449). Clicks held flat (134 vs 138) on slightly lower impressions (17372 vs 17589) — meaning we're earning the same clicks from fewer impressions, which is a CTR efficiency win (0.77% vs 0.78%). Redesign verdict at Day 8: no harm done, position metric trending in the right direction. Still below baseline volumes but the trajectory is constructive.

opportunities.opportunity: Calculator pages own #1-3 rankings for brand variants and dominate the SERP for calculator queries. Now the lift is title/meta CTR optimization — push 'Free' and a price-range preview ($X-Y/sq ft) into the meta description to convert page-1 impressions into clicks.

Position improved meaningfully but CTR is still suppressed — classic AI Overview cannibalization. Rebuild the homepage above-the-fold answer block into a question-answer pattern Google can cite. Add a FAQ-style introductory section before the hero CTA.

Still page 3 — but installation is your highest-margin service. Stand up a dedicated 'How We Install' page with process photos, install timelines for Phoenix/Mesa/Provo, and HowTo schema. Currently zero install how-to content.

Phoenix-local pos 38 vs US pos ~24 — the GBP profile is underperforming the website. Audit GBP: primary category, NAP consistency, service-area definitions, recent reviews. The site schema is doing its job; the GBP isn't.

content_strategy: Build the pet turf cluster — 0/8 keywords ranking in this group. 'artificial grass for dogs', 'dog run artificial grass', 'pet turf phoenix' are all unranked. Create a /pet-turf/ pillar page with sub-pages for dog runs, drainage specs, antimicrobial infill (Zeolite). High commercial intent + low competition.

Build the install-how-to cluster — 1/8 keywords ranking. 'how to install artificial turf', 'how to install turf with pavers' are search-volume winners with zero coverage. Each piece should funnel to /service-areas/ + the calculator. Use HowTo schema for rich-result eligibility.

Build the infill comparison content — 0/6 keywords ranking. 'best infill for artificial turf', 'silica vs rubber infill', 'zeolite infill' are mid-volume, commercial-intent queries. Single comparison page with table + decision tree converts to product pages.

Rewrite homepage above-the-fold answer block for 'artificial grass' — pos 2.7 with suppressed CTR signals AI Overview cannibalization. Restructure into a Question→Answer pattern Google can cite. Add a 50-word FAQ-style answer block before the hero CTA.

GBP optimization sprint — Phoenix-local rankings (avg pos 31.3) materially lag US rankings (avg pos 14.4) for the same keywords. The site is fine; the GBP isn't. Audit primary category, NAP across local directories, service-area definitions, and review velocity.
next_steps: Ship the pet turf cluster + install how-to pillar pages. These are the two biggest unaddressed content gaps and target highest commercial intent. Start with /pet-turf/ landing page — single biggest unranked-keyword cluster (8 keywords, 0 ranked).

GBP audit and optimization sprint. The 12-17 position gap between US and Phoenix-local rankings is almost entirely a GBP problem, not an on-site problem. Primary category, NAP consistency, service areas, review velocity — full audit, prioritized fixes.

Shorten /service-areas/utah/provo/ title from 68→64 characters to prevent SERP truncation. Currently 'Artificial Turf in Provo, UT | Local Yard & Utah County Supplier' — trim 'Utah County' or '& Utah County'. Single-line fix.
